messages:
Maria P: quick follow-up on API negotiation RFC — need rollout plan
Ajay S: what's highest-risk?
Kim L: header vs body field
Theo R: headers often stripped by proxies
ops-bot: reminder: unknown X-* headers may be dropped by some infra
Jordan (SRE): headers ok for canarying but ops must update allowlists
Mae: body.version is explicit but forces SDK bump
Maria P: proposal: phase1 header X-Redwood-API-Version; phase2 body.version in SDK vNext
Ajay S: enum values?
Kim L: none | v1 | v2-preview | v2-strict
Theo R: whitelist tokens only; no freeform
Maria P: fallback: best-effort + route to compatibility shim when strict behavior needed
Ajay S: CI needs contract matrix (client_sdk, header, body, expected, shim)
Kim L: I'll draft matrix; Mae will prototype SDK adapter
Jordan (SRE): infra will schedule allowlist changes and dashboards for shim_invocations
Maria P: timeline: 1w header+enum, 3w allowlist canary, 8w SDK draft, 12w strict routing
Mae: will add migration guide draft
Maria P: decision recorded; creating tracking issue. closing thread.
